strategies.name: Pipelined overlapping collectives with chunking

Uses async collective launches (8+ dispatches with overlapped execution) to hide latency behind computation, trading programming complexity for better network utilization.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction tree
strategies.desc: Exploit multi-node topology by performing intra-node collectives followed by inter-node collectives for each iteration. Uses 8 iterations × 2 levels = 16 dispatches but each intra-node collective has lower latency (fewer participants) and smaller inter-node payloads if aggregation is possible. Optimizes for node-local bandwidth and cross-node link congestion.

strategies.name: Fused all-reduce with packed metadata broadcast
strategies.desc:
Pack the 8 block means into a small metadata vector (size 8), perform separate all-reduce on means only via broadcast/reduce on scalars, then use computed scaling factors locally before final all-reduce. Uses 1 initial all-reduce + 7×(1 tiny all-reduce for means + 1 full all-reduce for scaled data) = 15 dispatches, but mean-only collectives are much cheaper due to tiny payload.
